title: init-project-context Phase 2 deep analysis output
description: Intermediate emitted by Phase 2 (Deep analysis) of /init-project-context. Phase 3 (Synthesis) consumes it to render CLAUDE.md, memories, and the Mermaid dependency graph. High-level only: nodes are projects / packages / module roots, never individual classes. The fallback.* flags record whether the preferred analyser was available per stack (only csharp + webforms have a non-grep preferred analyser today).

rootPath.description: Absolute path to the analysed project root, mirroring discovery.rootPath.

analysedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which deep analysis completed. Optional but recommended for audit.

notes.description: Free-form diagnostic strings (e.g. "roslyn CLI absent — used Grep fallback for C#"). Optional.

fallback.description: Per-stack flag: true means the analysis used the Grep fallback because the preferred analyser was unavailable. csharp + webforms prefer the roslyn CLI; python + typescript have no preferred analyser yet, so their flag is always false.

modules.description: Sorted lexicographically by id. Re-runs over the same tree must produce byte-identical JSON.

edges.description: Sorted lexicographically by (from, to, kind). Edges only connect modules present in modules[].

id.description: Stable identifier of the form `<stack>:<repo-relative-path>`. Unique across the modules array.

name.description: Display name (basename of the project / package / module root).

stack.description: Primary stack of the module. WebForms is NOT a separate module stack — webforms-hosting C# projects set webformsHost=true.

path.description: Repo-relative root of the module with forward-slash separators.

kind.description: project = C# .csproj. package = Python directory with __init__.py. module = TypeScript module root (directory with index.ts/main.ts or top-level src/ subdir).

exports.description: Sample of top-level public symbols (classes, functions, exports). Sorted lexicographically. Capped at 10 per module — this is for orientation, not enumeration.

webformsHost.description: Optional. Present and true on C# projects that host *.aspx pages (the WebForms front-end module of an AutoClone-family solution). Absent or false otherwise.

from.description: Module id of the source. Must match an entry in modules[].

to.description: Module id of the target. Must match an entry in modules[].

kind.description: ProjectReference = C# <ProjectReference Include="..."/>. import = Python `from X import …` / `import X` between known packages, or TypeScript `import … from "…"` between known modules.
